$description: Every shared component of the Follow Me Therapy design system: what it is, its rules, which component tokens it takes (design/tokens.json › component.<tokens>), and where each product implements it. CI checks this file in every product: each listed implementation must exist, a product that doesn't have a component must say why ("none"), and a component with tokens must take its colours from them, never from a colour directly. To add or change a component: change it here first, then in every product (the checks fail until they match).

products.designSystem: Samwisee/follow-me-therapy: design/design-system/project/components (css: bundle.css selector; react: export in src/index.tsx). Also used by the worksheets and books.

Chip.description: A pill label, outlined in its line colour; a link chip is a 44px target.
rules: Fill tint, words ink, outline line; on hover a link chip's outline turns solid.
A chip on its own tone's ground (the lilac hero, the app bar, a note) turns paper (chip.fill-on-ground).

ToggleChip.description: A chip you tap to choose (days of the week, an option): a toggle button.
rules: Off: paper with the tone's line and ink. On: the tone's tint, a solid outline and a tick, so it never relies on colour alone.
A 44px target; announced as on or off.

website.none: The website has nothing to choose.

FilterChip.description: A chip that filters a list (All, Self-care, Feelings…), or an icon chip that shows or hides a part of the page (the info chip).
rules: In the tone of what it filters (Self-care purple, Feelings teal, Home practice sun).
Off: paper with the tone's line and ink. On: the tone's ink as the fill with white words, no tick: the light-to-dark change shows it (at least 3:1 against paper), so it never relies on hue.
An icon-only chip (info) carries a spoken label; a 44px target; announced as selected or on.

website.none: The website has nothing to filter.

Tag.description: A small solid label above a title (Self-care, Telehealth).
rules: Solid fill, words in on-solid (paper; ink on sun).

IconTile.description: A rounded square of tint with a line icon in the tone.
rules: Tint fill, icon colour, outlined in line.
Inside a tinted container the tile is paper (tile.fill-on-ground).

InfoNote.description: A tinted, outlined note with an icon tile. Two layouts: wrap (long notes: words wrap round the tile) and centred (short tips: words centred beside it).
rules: Ground fill, line outline, paper tile with the tone's icon.
Corner nests round the tile: radius-tile + card-pad + outline.
Short notes centre; long ones wrap so they never squeeze into a narrow column.

Head.description: An activity's header: tinted panel, title with one swash, the tag beneath (worksheets, app activities).
rules: Ground fill, line outline, corner nests (radius-tile + card-pad + outline).

website.none: The website has no activities; its hero plays this part.

Panel.description: A tinted section of a screen: a heading and what it holds, on the tone's ground, outlined in its line.
rules: Ground fill, line outline, corner nested (radius-tile + card-pad + outline).
Its words start card-pad + outline in: the same text edge as every group and note on the screen.
Something on a panel sits on that ground: a chip of the same tone turns paper, tiles turn paper.

website.none: The website's full-width bands (lilac, butter, mint) play this part.

Card.description: A container you tap: service card (tile beside the title, a sentence, centred Learn more ›), action card (button at the foot), list row (tile, words, chevron).
rules: Tappable containers are outlined in the tone's solid colour; static ones in its line colour.
Paper fill; lifts on hover, presses in on tap.
Corner nests round what sits in it: the tile, or the button (button/2 + card-pad + outline).
A row for an activity with progress always shows its bar (empty until started) and, when done, a teal tick in place of the chevron; it says 'done' to screen readers.

Choices.description: Choice tiles: tap to choose on screens, circle on paper.
rules: Paper with a line outline; chosen: tint fill and a solid outline, never colour alone (a tick or a thicker outline too).

Button.description: A pill button in the heading face, button-height tall. Solid, outline or quiet.
rules: Solid: strong fill, white words, a soft glow. Outline: paper with the strong colour. Quiet: sun tint.
Disabled: paper, ink-soft words, purple-line outline.
Chevron (›) for going on, never an arrow.

Swash.description: The hand-drawn sun underline under one key word; one per page.
rules: Sun colour, repeating squiggle the width of the word.

SectionTitle.description: A centred section title with a short squiggle in the band's accent and an optional subtitle.

TickList.description: Plain lines, each with a teal tick circle (an empty box on paper).

StepPath.description: Numbered steps along a path (How it works, a routine).

Tracker.description: A week of stars: activities down the side, days across.
rules: Activities down, days across; each star a 44px target between dashed rules.
Tapping a star adds it with the same burst as the WeekCalendar (spring, twist, sparkles); not with reduced motion.

WeekCalendar.description: A week of an activity plan as the practice week's stars: the days across (today marked), each activity's row of stars: not planned (a dot), planned (an outline star), partly done (a pale star) or done (a gold star).
rules: Days Monday to Sunday with their dates; today's column on lilac. Each row's stars sit between dashed rules, the activity's name above, as on the practice week (Tracker).
Not planned: a small dot. Planned: a purple outline star. Partly done: a pale sun star. Done: a gold star outlined in sun-deep.
A row can be tapped to add or take away a star (practice); the others are read-only.
Adding a star bursts: the star springs in with a twist and sparkles fly out (purple, teal, sun, pink). Not with reduced motion.
Never colour alone: filled against outline, and each day is read out (Monday, Morning routine: done).

Logo.description: The mark and the lockup (mark + Follow Me Therapy at weight-brand).

Wave.description: The gentle wave where one band meets the next.

AppBar.description: The app's lilac top bar: back button, title (or the lockup on the home screen), progress for flows, a shallow wave with a line stroke. One bar stays put while screens change.
rules: Lilac fill; the wave (bar.wave) is outlined in bar.line.
The tabs share one bar with the lockup (the tab bar says where you are); a flow shows its title, a back button and its progress.
Persistent: its parts animate, it never rebuilds.

website.none: The website uses its menu (the rail and the top bar).

TabBar.description: The app's lilac tab bar: icon and label per tab; a wave crest rises over the chosen tab and glides between tabs.
rules: The chosen tab: crest, purple icon, bold purple-ink label (never colour alone).
Top edge stroked in bar.line.

ActionBar.description: A flow's buttons (Back at the start, the next step at the end), floating at the bottom with no panel. They stay on screen between steps and morph.

ProgressBar.description: A slim purple-line track with a purple fill that glides to its length.

StepFocus.description: One step, big: Step n of N, the number in a disc (teal with a tick when done), the words in the heading face.
rules: Purple tint disc with the number; done turns teal with a white tick (and says 'done' to screen readers), never colour alone.

Celebration.description: The end of a flow: a sun disc with a star that springs in, a title with the swash, a short message.
rules: Sun disc, a sun star outlined in sun-deep, springs in; the title carries the swash.

Breathing.description: A breathing guide: a teal disc that grows for four seconds (breathe in) and shrinks for four (breathe out), the words changing to match.
rules: Teal tint disc, teal-line outline, a teal centre; 8s loop; with reduced motion it holds still and the words lead.

FootstepTrail.description: Anatomical footprints walking left and right (the brand's 'follow me').

app.none: Not used in the app yet.

CutLine.description: A dashed line to cut along (print).

Page.description: A printed page: A4 worksheet or A5 book page.

app.none: Print only; the app uses FmtFlowScaffold.
